name: og-e
description: UI helper for OGame: floating Send Exp/Col, galaxy scan tracker, abandon overlay. Requires AntiGameReborn. See README.md.

scripts.build: npm run clean && rollup -c && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && rollup -c --environment NODE_ENV:production && node scripts/copy-static.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build:prod && node scripts/package.mjs && node scripts/package-source.mjs
